title: Behind the Voices
theme: Disney voice actors and the voices of the parks
intro: [whispers] Shhh... hear that? That's the sound of tonight's theme. [excited] It's BEHIND THE VOICES! The legends who gave Disney characters their laughs, their songs, and their very loud parrot squawks.

art.prompt: A vintage voice recording booth glowing in warm amber light, a classic studio microphone with a pop filter, headphones on a stand, a script on a music stand, sound waves rippling through the air as colorful ribbons, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Phenomenal Cosmic Voices
categories.intro: [excited] Rub the lamp! This category is all about the voices of Aladdin. Phenomenal cosmic powers, itty bitty recording booth.

art.prompt: A moonlit desert palace balcony with a glowing golden oil lamp on a cushion, a studio microphone beside it, a flying carpet silhouette against the stars and wisps of blue magic smoke, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Robin Williams improvised hours of material as this blue, shape-shifting wish-granter.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Genie! [laughs] Robin Williams recorded hours of improv. Hours! The animators had to sprint to keep up.

clues.clue: Comedian Gilbert Gottfried gave his famously loud voice to this sarcastic red parrot.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Iago! [sarcastic] Gilbert Gottfried, known for his soft gentle whisper. Kidding. My ears are still ringing.

clues.clue: This Tony-winning star from the Philippines provided Jasmine's singing voice, including A Whole New World.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lea Salonga! [excited] And she sang for Mulan too. Two princesses, one incredible voice.

clues.clue: Broadway actor Jonathan Freeman voiced this villain in the 1992 film, then played him again on Broadway.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jafar! [mischievously] Jonathan Freeman has been delightfully evil in that role for over thirty years.

clues.clue: Linda Larkin provided the SPEAKING voice of this character.
clues.reveal: [dramatic pause] The correct answer is Princess Jasmine! Linda Larkin talked, Lea Salonga sang. Teamwork makes the dream work.

categories.title: Name That Character
categories.intro: [chuckles] I give you the famous voice, you give me the character they played. Simple! [whispers] Mostly simple.

art.prompt: A dark velvet theater with a row of spotlit empty character costumes on hangers: a cowboy hat, a scarf, a warrior helmet and a purple feathered headdress, each beside a microphone, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Tom Hanks voices this pull-string cowboy sheriff.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Woody! [excited] Reach for the sky! Tom's brother Jim voices Woody on lots of toys and games, too.

clues.clue: Ellen DeGeneres voices this forgetful blue tang fish.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dory! [laughs] Just keep swimming. And keep forgetting. And keep swimming.

clues.clue: Ming-Na Wen voices this warrior, who disguises herself as Ping.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mulan! [excited] Ming-Na Wen later went on to Star Wars. A true warrior in two galaxies.

clues.clue: Ed Asner voiced this grumpy widower who flies his house to South America with balloons.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Carl Fredricksen! [sighs] And the first ten minutes of that movie still wreck me.

clues.clue: Singer Eartha Kitt purred her way through this power-hungry royal adviser in The Emperor's New Groove.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yzma! [laughs] Pull the lever, Kronk! WRONG LEVERRRR!

categories.title: Voice Booth Props
categories.intro: [mischievously] These props belong to famous characters. I'll tell you who voices them, you tell me who OWNS the stuff!

art.prompt: A cluttered voice-over studio shelf full of mysterious props: a toy helmet, a frying pan, a chef's hat, round glasses and a jar of fireflies, lit by a warm studio lamp, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Tim Allen voices the owner of this gear. Who is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! [excited] To infinity and beyond! Tim Allen has been voicing him since 1995.

media.prompt: A child's bedroom floor with a toy astronaut helmet, folded toy spaceship wings and a toy laser beam blaster under a window of glowing star decals and a cloud-painted wall, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Mandy Moore voices the owner of these things. Who is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rapunzel! [laughs] Who knew a frying pan would be the greatest weapon of all time?

media.prompt: A tall stone tower window with an extremely long golden braid spilling out, a cast-iron frying pan, a paintbrush and a small crown on the sill, floating lanterns in the distance, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Patton Oswalt voices the owner of this tiny chef's hat. Who is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Remy! [chuckles] A rat with better knife skills than me. Anyone can cook!

media.prompt: A tiny white chef's hat sitting beside a big pot of ratatouille in a bustling Paris restaurant kitchen at night, copper pans and the Eiffel Tower in the window, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: The film's own director voiced the owner of these big round glasses. Who is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Edna Mode! Brad Bird voiced her himself. [sarcastic] And she has ONE rule for superhero costumes. No capes!

media.prompt: A sleek modern fashion design studio with oversized round black glasses resting on a sketchbook full of superhero costume drawings, fabric swatches and a mannequin, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

clues.clue: Jim Cummings, the voice of Winnie the Pooh, also voices the owner of this glowing back end. Who is it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ray! [sighs] That sweet firefly in love with his Evangeline. Somebody hand me a tissue.

media.prompt: A glowing firefly light hovering over a misty Louisiana bayou at night, cypress trees with Spanish moss, lily pads and a bright evening star above, no people, no text, no logos, no copyrighted characters

categories.title: Voices in the Parks
categories.intro: [excited] Some of the most famous Disney voices never appear on screen. They live in the PARKS! Let's listen in.

art.prompt: A dusky theme park scene with a misty river boat dock, a monorail beam curving past, a spooky manor silhouette on a hill and a giant geodesic sphere glowing in the distance, sound waves drifting through the air, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: On the Jungle Cruise, these boat guides tell terrible puns into a microphone.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Skippers! [laughs] The backside of water. Every. Single. Time. And we still laugh.

clues.clue: Please stand clear of the doors, followed by the same line in Spanish, is the famous announcement on this Walt Disney World ride.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the monorail! [chuckles] Por favor manténganse alejados de las puertas. We all know it by heart.

clues.clue: In the Haunted Mansion, the unseen narrator who welcomes foolish mortals is known as this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Ghost Host! [whispers] And our tour begins here, in this gallery...

clues.clue: This voice actor was the Haunted Mansion's Ghost Host and also the Pirates of the Caribbean auctioneer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paul Frees! [laughs] He also voiced Ludwig Von Drake. One voice, a hundred ghosts and pirates.

clues.clue: From 1994 to 2007, Spaceship Earth was narrated by this Oscar-winning actor, who also voiced Scar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jeremy Irons! [chuckles] Today Dame Judi Dench is your time-travel tour guide.

categories.title: Name That Actor
categories.intro: [mischievously] Now we flip it! I tell you the role, you tell me the human behind the microphone.

art.prompt: A Hollywood walk-of-fame style sidewalk of blank golden stars under spotlights leading to a glowing recording studio door, film reels and microphones in soft focus, 16:9, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This singer-actress voices Elsa and belted out Let It Go.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Idina Menzel! [excited] She held that final note so long the castle built itself.

clues.clue: Nicknamed The Rock, he voices the demigod Maui.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dwayne Johnson! [laughs] What can I say except... you're welcome.

clues.clue: This Book of Mormon Broadway star voices Olaf.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Josh Gad! [chuckles] Some people are worth melting for. Some actors are worth casting for.

clues.clue: He gave Donald Duck his quack from 1934 until his death in 1985.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Clarence Ducky Nash! [laughs] Over fifty years of quacking. My throat hurts just thinking about it.

clues.clue: Wayne Allwine voiced Mickey Mouse for over thirty years, and he was married to this actress, the voice of Minnie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Russi Taylor! [sighs] Mickey and Minnie, married in real life. That's the sweetest fact in show business.
